## NeMo Helix OpenShell Tasks Container

This container is the OpenShell-compatible variant of the NeMo Helix Tasks
container. It runs platform job steps inside OpenShell sandboxes and adds the
sandbox user, the supervisor's system dependencies, and a bundled jobs launcher.

### Resources

[Documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo-helix)
